about_the_game:
DLC-exclusive attachment items. Contains 7 different eyewear designs.

Earring (Left) x2
Earring (Right) x2
Earring (Both) x2
Mana Seed Earrings: Valor x2
Mana Seed Earrings: Fortitude x2
Mana Seed Earrings: Optimism x2
Crab Earrings x2

*Open [DLC] under [Items] in the main menu and select new items to receive them.
*After receiving items, change costumes via [Equipment] -> [Costumes] in the main menu.
